posts.subject: [ENG] Dealing with hackers ( DREAM NEWS )
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello dear community,


There are news about dealing with cheaters.
Unfortunately it happens again and again that users or members are cheating on the game servers.
Every now and then a suspicion is confirmed by a VAC BAN.
The Dream Team stands clearly against cheaters using external software to gain an unfair advantage over other players.


For this reason more critical actions will be taken against such players.


From 1 July 2017 the following rules apply:


  • A player that has played on one of the game servers will receive a VAC BAN on his account so he is ruled out from playing on all the servers


Meaning: If the account has more than 0 stamm points on the Dream Servers and gets banned, all his current accounts (synonymous/ smurfs) of the following user will also get banned without warning, however a community exclusion will not be applied.


  • If a player shows a suspicious game or has suspicious actions way too often and has at least 3 other accounts (synonymous/ smurfs) which received a VAC BAN within the last 365 days ( 1 year ) even if the player did not use them to play on the game servers.

The reason for this is a assumption that someone has bought 3 different accounts within a period of 365 days to an exclusion, which means that the cheater has not learned anything from his mistakes and the gameplay might suggest that an unfair advantage is acquired.


  • The following rules above only apply to VAC BAN's, which were received in CS:GO

To prove the VAC BAN is regarding a other game, you can simply "connect" to the game servers.


We wish you a Cheat-Free and positive experience on the game servers.
If you have any questions regarding the rules or would like to report a suspicious player, pleas contact one of the administrators on the Teamspeak³ or in the forum.
